fixed_goal: Large complex parent-scene DRL training, frozen rapid complete local planning; SL and rules auxiliary only

training.only_major_variable: Replace detached LOO by action-independent frozen SL256 greedy+sameH cost on identical input
training.baseline: Frozen SL256, D1 actor-only load per input, fresh greedy encode/prefix, sameH, no policy RNG consumption or promotion. Reference and sample terminals have disjoint exact128LRU caches.
training.rng: Original v3 NamedStreams seed11622026 phaseRL/update/slot/primary,forced_low,forced_high. B slot names retained, no forced actions.
training.distribution: Exact B128 frozen512 views,64full and64local batches
training.checkpoint: 0,32,64,96,128 full Adam/RNG/ref+sample state; full gradients/new weights every update

evaluation.neural: D1 actor-only each request, greedy+sameH, explicit study_method/checkpoint_role/tensor/source
evaluation.native: Original endpoint adapters, no extra common H
evaluation.navigation: Identical saved physical D source for every method, only navigation cached. First saved-D read paid in actual request, timing descriptive, not paired deployment proof.
evaluation.statistics: Per true physical layout average6 sizes/endpoints; compute (J_control-J_G)/J_control. Equal weight12 parents, bootstrap20000 draws stratified mixed6/blocked6, PCG64 seed11642026, percentile2.5/97.5 linear; raw separately.

gate.logical: AND all3 plus all432 feasible/finite/identity-valid; only single-seed mechanism candidate, no final deployment/generalization claim

budgets.engineering: Synthetic logits only, no real policy/nav/native/H, max120s inside shared7200
budgets.charging: Count requests including cache hits before work. Include registration CPU/IO, all runtime preparation, baseline greedy,H, training, validation, checkpoints and IO. Git publication/read-only post-run audit are separate maintenance.

mathematics: State-only frozen baseline subtracts zero expected score, preserving expected J objective; clipping/Adam/finite-sample training do not guarantee monotonic greedy quality.
stop: Any source/role/infeasible/nonfinite/validation/IO/cap error retains all debits and last closed checkpoint, no replacement/reseed/free retry, no resetting experiment folders.
historical: Old role files and mapping preserved, old108 labels not rewritten; no A/B/C retrain, deployment-grid rerun, oldS3 missing refill or original60/newS3 semantic access.
